# scylladbcloud_cloud_accounts (Data Source)

The cloud accounts clusters can run in: ScyllaDB's own and any bring-your-own accounts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scylladbcloud_cloud_accounts" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Read-Only

- `cloud_accounts` (List of Object) Cloud accounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_accounts))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
